expect.statement: Every exported symbol is traceable through index files all the way down to the package root, `src/index.ts`.
expect.quote:
We will make each exported symbol traceable through index files all the way down
to the root of the package, `src/index.ts`.

expect.statement: An index file re-exports only from its own immediate directory children, and only index files contain re-exports.
expect.quote:
Each index file will only re-export
from its own immediate directory children, and only index files will have
re-exports.

expect.statement: An index file that re-exports another index file uses the wildcard form.
expect.quote:
index files that are re-exporting other index files should always
use wildcard form

expect.statement: An index file that re-exports symbols from non-index files enumerates every export explicitly.
expect.quote:
Index files that are re-exporting symbols from non-index files should always
enumerate all exports

expect.statement: Imports that bypass an index file are discouraged, though they may sometimes be necessary.
expect.quote:
Imports that bypass an index file are discouraged, but may sometimes be
necessary
